# Run evals from your agent.

Connect the Ethos Evals MCP server to Claude Code, Claude, Cursor or Codex and ask in plain English. Your agent searches the catalogue, prices the run, launches it and reads back the results, with the same access you have in the web app.

Server URL`https://pollen.prod.askethos.com/mcp/evals/`Click to copy

Invite-only beta: signing in needs an invited Ethos Evals account.Request an invite →

## Connect your agent

### Claude Code

1. Run this in your terminal.
2. In Claude Code, run /mcp, pick ethos-evals and choose Authenticate.
3. Sign in with your invited Ethos Evals account in the browser window that opens.

`claude mcp add --transport http ethos-evals https://pollen.prod.askethos.com/mcp/evals/`Click to copy

### Claude (claude.ai and desktop)

1. Open Settings → Connectors and choose Add custom connector.
2. Name it Ethos Evals and paste the server URL.
3. Choose Connect and sign in with your invited Ethos Evals account.

`https://pollen.prod.askethos.com/mcp/evals/`Click to copy

### Cursor

1. Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or your project’s .cursor/mcp.json).
2. Open Cursor Settings → MCP; ethos-evals asks you to sign in on first use.
3. Sign in with your invited Ethos Evals account.

`{"mcpServers": {"ethos-evals": {"url": "https://pollen.prod.askethos.com/mcp/evals/"}}}`Click to copy

### Codex

1. Run this in your terminal.
2. Sign in with your invited Ethos Evals account when Codex asks.

`codex mcp add ethos-evals --url https://pollen.prod.askethos.com/mcp/evals/`Click to copy

## Sign in

The server signs you in with OAuth: the first time your agent connects, a browser window opens on the Ethos sign-in page. Sign in with the account your invite was sent to. There is no API key to create or paste.

Your agent then acts as you. It sees the evals, organisations and settings you can see in the web app, and every permission is the web app's own: billing tools, for example, work for organisation owners and admins only.

Not invited yet? Request an invite. Already invited? [Log in to the web app](https://evals.askethos.com/pollen/login?returnTo=%2Fwelcome%3Freferring_domain%3Dgoogle.com%26landing_path%3D%252Fmcp).

## What to ask

### Compare two models on a benchmark

> “Run GPQA Diamond on these two models. Show me the cost first, then tell me which questions they disagree on.”

1. [`list_benchmarks`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_benchmarks)
2. [`list_models`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_models)
3. [`estimate_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-estimate_eval)
4. [`run_benchmark`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_benchmark)
5. [`get_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval)
6. [`get_eval_results`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval_results)
7. [`list_prompts`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_prompts)
8. [`get_prompt`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_prompt)

get\_eval reports progress until the eval completes; list\_prompts sorted by score difference finds where the models split.

### Evaluate your own model

> “Save our endpoint as a model, then score it against two frontier models on Terminal-Bench and show me where it fails.”

1. [`save_model`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-save_model)
2. [`estimate_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-estimate_eval)
3. [`run_benchmark`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_benchmark)
4. [`get_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval)
5. [`get_eval_results`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval_results)
6. [`list_trials`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_trials)
7. [`get_trial_trace`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_trace)

save\_model checks the endpoint once and stores its key; each run then names it as runs\[\].saved\_model\_id, next to hosted models.

### Run an eval on your own data

> “Preview this Hugging Face dataset, price an eval of three models on it, and run it once I approve the estimate.”

1. [`preview_huggingface_dataset`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-preview_huggingface_dataset)
2. [`estimate_dataset_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-estimate_dataset_eval)
3. [`run_eval_from_huggingface`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_eval_from_huggingface)
4. [`get_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval)
5. [`get_eval_results`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval_results)
6. [`export_eval`](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-export_eval)

For a local file, run\_eval\_from\_file takes the rows directly.

## What it costs

Connecting and reading are free. Evals are charged to your organisation's credit, at the rates on the [pricing page](https://evals.askethos.com/pricing).

- Price a run first: `estimate_eval` for a benchmark, `estimate_dataset_eval` for your own data or a re-run. Estimates create nothing and cost nothing.
- Tools that start or retry evals (`run_benchmark`, `run_eval_from_file`,`run_eval_from_huggingface`, `rerun_eval`, `retry_eval`,`retry_failed_trials`) spend credit as trials finish. A good agent shows you the estimate and waits for your go-ahead before it calls one.
- Owners and admins can check spend with `get_credit_balance` and `get_usage`, and buy credit through `create_top_up_link`: nothing is charged until a person completes the checkout.

## Tools

68 tools, grouped by job. This list is read from the server itself.

### Catalogue

Find benchmarks, models, judges and agent harnesses.

`list_benchmarks`Search benchmarksSearch the benchmark catalogue.

`get_benchmark`Get a benchmarkOne benchmark's full catalogue entry, including its complete description.

`get_benchmark_anatomy`Look inside a benchmarkWhat a benchmark actually asks of a model, shown on two real sample tasks.

`list_models`Search modelsModels you can evaluate.

`list_judge_models`List judge modelsModels that can grade answers (`judge_model` on the create tools), and the default.

`list_harnesses`List agent harnessesAgent harnesses an agentic benchmark can run under (`harness_id` on run\_benchmark).

### Create and run

Price an eval, then start it on a benchmark, your own data or a copy of an earlier run.

`estimate_eval`Estimate an eval's costPrice a benchmark eval before running it; nothing is created.

`estimate_dataset_eval`Estimate the cost of an eval on your data or a copyPrice an eval on your own data, a Hugging Face dataset or a copy of an eval before running it; nothing is created.

`run_benchmark`Run a benchmarkStart an eval of one or more models on a benchmark.

`run_eval_from_file`Run an eval on your own dataStart an eval on your own dataset: each row is one prompt, answered by every model and graded.

`preview_huggingface_dataset`Preview a Hugging Face datasetLook at a Hugging Face dataset before running it: its configs, splits, columns (per config), row count and a few sample rows of the selected config.

`run_eval_from_huggingface`Run an eval on a Hugging Face datasetStart an eval on a Hugging Face dataset; each row is one prompt.

`rerun_eval`Re-run an evalRun a copy of an eval you own (or one in an organisation you administer), on the same prompts, as a new eval you own.

`request_benchmark`Request a new benchmarkAsk for a benchmark that is not in the library, and queue an eval of your models on it.

### Manage

Follow, rename, cancel and retry your evals.

`list_evals`List evalsEvals you can see, newest first: your own, ones shared with you and (as an organisation owner or admin) the rest of your organisations'.

`get_eval`Get an evalEverything about one eval: status, progress counts, settings, per-model summaries, the comparative report, cost cap, why it stopped, and its credit charge.

`rename_eval`Rename an evalRename an eval (its owner, or an owner/admin of its organisation).

`cancel_eval`Cancel an evalStop an eval that hasn't finished: pending or running.

`retry_eval`Retry an evalRun a completed, failed or cancelled eval again, keeping the trials that already finished.

`retry_failed_trials`Retry failed trials mid-runWhile an eval is still running, re-run the failed trials of models that have already finished.

`generate_interim_report`Generate an interim reportWrite the comparative report now, from the results so far, while the eval is still running.

### Results

Scores, per-prompt answers, agent trajectories, files and exports.

`get_eval_results`Get scoresPer-model scores: average and raw score, latency, output length, completed count, a per-prompt score list (omitted on very large evals) and `winner_analysis`.

`compare_evals`Compare evalsSide-by-side scores for several evals (the UI's Compare page): each eval's name, status, benchmark and per-model average score, latency and completed count.

`list_prompts`Search promptsSearch and sort an eval's prompts, e.g. to find where one model beats another.

`list_prompt_tags`List prompt tagsEvery tag and its values across an eval's prompts (for list\_prompts `tags`).

`get_prompt`Get a prompt's resultsOne prompt in full: its text, the expected answer or rubric, and every model's output, scores, judge explanation, tokens and latency.

`list_trials`List agent trialsAn agentic eval's trials and per-run statistics (success rate, pass@k, consensus, steps, time, tokens).

`get_trial_trace`Get a trial's trajectoryOne agent trial: reward, final answer, timings, the grader's verdict, the files and screenshots it produced plus the grader's own output files (fetch any of them with get\_trial\_file), and a page of its steps.

`get_trial_step`Get one trial step in fullOne step of a trial in full: its message, tool calls and whole observation (text past 2 MB is cut).

`get_trial_file`Get a trial's screenshot or fileA screenshot (returned as an image), a file the agent produced, or a grader output file such as `verifier/reward-details.json` (returned as text, or base64 for binary files up to 5 MB).

`get_trial_grader_logs`Get a trial's grader logsThe grader's stdout and stderr for one trial: the best clue when a trial has no trajectory or a surprising score.

`get_trial_download_link`Get a trial download linkOne trial's trajectory or a download link for its workspace tarball.

`export_eval`Export an evalExport an eval's results.

### Sharing

Share an eval with colleagues or by a public link.

`get_sharing`See who an eval is shared withWho this eval is shared with: `collaborators` (people with an Ethos account; the full list for the eval's owner, the owners/admins of the eval's organisation and Ethos staff, only yourself otherwise) and its live `public_links` (null unless you own the eval).

`get_share_link`Get a share linkThe eval's share link for people with an Ethos account (owner only).

`accept_share_link`Accept a share linkAccept a share link someone sent you, giving you read access to their eval.

`remove_collaborator`Remove a collaboratorRemove a collaborator (owner only).

`create_public_link`Create a public linkCreate a public link anyone can open without signing in: a read-only view of the eval's results and traces (owner only).

`revoke_public_link`Revoke a public linkTurn off a public link immediately (owner only).

`set_screenshot_sharing`Share screenshotsLet collaborators and public-link viewers see trial screenshots (owner only).

### Organisations

Teams, members and invites.

`list_organizations`List your organisationsYour organisations and your role in each (owner, admin or member).

`create_organization`Create a team organisationCreate a team organisation, with you as its owner (when list\_organizations says `can_create_team`).

`rename_organization`Rename an organisationRename a team organisation (owners and admins).

`delete_organization`Delete an organisationDelete a team organisation (owners only).

`leave_organization`Leave an organisationLeave a team organisation.

`list_organization_members`List members and invitesA team organisation's `members` (with roles) and its pending and expired `invites` (owners and admins).

`invite_to_organization`Invite someoneEmail someone an invite to a team organisation (owners and admins; only an owner can invite an owner).

`resend_invite`Resend an inviteSend an expired invite again, as a new invite (owners and admins).

`cancel_invite`Cancel an inviteCancel a pending invite so its link stops working (owners and admins).

`accept_organization_invite`Accept an inviteJoin an organisation from an invite you received.

`change_member_role`Change a member's roleChange a member's role (owners and admins; only an owner grants or removes the owner role, and the last owner stays an owner).

`remove_organization_member`Remove a memberRemove a member (owners and admins; only an owner removes an owner).

### Billing

Credit, usage, invoices and top-ups (organisation owners and admins).

`get_credit_balance`Get credit balanceAn organisation's prepaid credit (owners and admins): balance, week-to-date spend, top-up packs, low-balance alert, auto top-up settings and saved card, and the newest ledger entries (10 unless you ask for up to 50).

`get_usage`Get usageWhat each eval cost the organisation, newest first (owners and admins): estimate, amount charged so far, and `state` (estimated = not started, reserved = running and charging as trials finish, settled = finished, released or skipped = nothing charged).

`export_usage_csv`Export usage as CSVThe organisation's eval charges for a date range as CSV (owners and admins), one row per eval at customer price: every eval whose charge settled in the range or that has any billing entry in it (a running eval's charges, a later correction or credit-back on an earlier eval).

`list_billing_documents`List invoices and receiptsThe organisation's invoices and receipts (owners and admins), each with its total, status and links to view or download it.

`update_billing_settings`Change billing settingsChange the low-balance email and automatic top-up (owners and admins).

`create_top_up_link`Get a top-up linkA secure checkout link to buy credit (owners and admins).

`add_payment_card`Get a link to save a cardA secure link to save a card for automatic top-up (owners and admins).

### Your settings

Your own models, provider keys and email notifications.

`list_saved_models`List your saved modelsYour saved models ("Your models": your own OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Hugging Face checkpoints), yours and your organisations'.

`save_model`Save your own modelSave your own model so evals can call it.

`test_saved_model`Test a saved modelCall a saved model once to check it still answers.

`rename_saved_model`Rename a saved modelRename a saved model.

`delete_saved_model`Delete a saved modelDelete a saved model and its stored key.

`list_provider_keys`List your provider keysYour saved model-provider keys for bring-your-own-key runs: id, provider, label and the last four characters, never the key.

`add_provider_key`Save a provider keySave a model-provider key for bring-your-own-key runs.

`delete_provider_key`Delete a provider keyDelete a saved provider key and its stored secret.

`set_email_notifications`Email notification settingsYour eval email notifications.
